title: Citations by DOI, and the warning I read past for a month
description: A reference manager moved its database, a build script swallowed the error, and every build for a month reported success. Rebuilding the pipeline around DOIs and crossref, and why Zotero stays as the other half.

title: BI is back in its era of ferment
description: Two revenue numbers from one dataset, a month building agent-assisted BI on Wren's semantic layer, and what innovation theory (dominant designs, eras of ferment, lock-in) says to do while the dashboard era is being challenged.

title: An early-access test of TypeSafe's Jev: calibrated judgments for half a cent
description: An early-access test of TypeSafe's Jev, a model that answers typed questions with probabilities and writes no text. I ran it on 24 Norwegian responses to the 2022 hearing on resource rent tax for salmon farming. Agreement with a frontier model's labels, calibration, cost and latency, next to DeepSeek V4.1 Flash with and without reasoning, and why an evolutionary economist goes looking for the odd variant.

title: Audio on a static site: build-time TTS and the script it reads from
description: This post has an audio version in a clone of my own voice, generated at build time with Fish Audio S2.1 Pro and committed next to the PDFs. What the dyslexia research says, why the pipeline emits a readable script before it makes any sound, the four things the script got wrong, and why the whole thing is shelved for now.

title: A subscribe button does not need a Worker
description: The newsletter moved off Cloudflare Workers and onto the mail server in a day: one Rust service, a Postgres with four tables, addresses sealed at rest, and a record of which issue went to whom. Why a mail store as a database was the right workaround in February and the wrong one now, what the move cut from the attack surface, and what the research on LLM-written code says about doing this with a coding agent without the complexity creeping back.
